long_biography.plain_text:
Injectable medicines became the focus of the Ravensburg family company that Helmut Vetter started from a pharmacy in 1950. His son Udo brought back manufacturing experience gained at Schering-Plough in the United States. He led Vetter's technical arm during its automation and international development, helping reposition the enterprise as a full-service pharmaceutical partner.

The second-generation transition placed Vetter at the head of the owner families and, in 2008, chair of the advisory board. His later work extended beyond stewardship of the inherited company. UV-Cap backs medium-sized life-sciences businesses, while his founding role and board leadership at ITM applied the same sector expertise to radiopharmaceuticals.
